today.welcomeBody: Create a project, save your go-to replies, or upload an offer and let us sort out the details.
today.nextActionsEmpty: Nothing due soon. New to-dos will show up here.

finance.revenueEmpty: No payments received yet. The chart updates as you record them.
finance.metricNetNote: Received minus paid — not accounting profit
finance.footnote: Received and paid filter by settled date; outstanding and to-pay by recorded date. You set the tax rate per entry; withholding, exchange differences, and tax-filing adjustments aren't included. TWD only for now.
finance.voidHelp: Void an entry made by mistake or duplicated: it drops out of every total but stays here and can be restored. Past months don't need voiding — use the date filter.

projects.empty: No matching projects. Add your first one or adjust the filters.

phaseCaption.negotiation: Offers, quotes, and getting to a signature. Replies to messages stay in the inbox.
phaseCaption.execution: Signed work: track deliverables, schedule, and payment milestones.
phaseCaption.settlement: After delivery: invoicing, balances, and closed projects.
phaseCaption.ended: Declined or cancelled projects, kept for reference.

stageNote.offer: Just received — confirm the type of work and the basics.
stageNote.negotiating: Replying and settling terms; no execution to-dos yet.
stageNote.signed: Signed — schedule deliverables, travel, and payment milestones.
stageNote.in_progress: Underway — deliverables, travel, and payment milestones are on the to-do list.
stageNote.collecting_payment: Delivered — track invoices, the balance, and costs.
stageNote.closed: Delivery and payments reconciled; the project is done.
stageNote.cancelled: The project was cancelled. Handle any remaining payments on their own.

projects.notSignedNote: Still in negotiation. Once it's signed (stage 已簽約 / Signed or later), you can add linked to-dos, events, and payments.

workflow.toConfirm: What to confirm for this project
workflow.draftForProject: Draft a reply for this project
workflow.hasIncome: Payment requests already exist — edit those below so nothing is counted twice.

warn.noItems: No calendar items or deliverable to-dos yet
warn.openTodos: {count, plural, one {# to-do still open} other {# to-dos still open}}
warn.overbilled: Billed {amount} more than quoted — check for duplicates or an outdated quote
warn.shortfall: Received {amount} less than billed (withholding or fees? please check)
warn.unpaidCosts: {count, plural, one {# cost not paid yet} other {# costs not paid yet}}

workflow.allClear: Recorded to-dos and payments reconcile; still confirm deliverables and contract obligations yourself.
workflow.stageNote: You decide the stage — changing it doesn't record payments or complete to-dos.
workflow.planIntro: Creates two outstanding payments from this project's tax-inclusive quote. This doesn't mean anything has been paid.
workflow.planInvalid: Check the quote and percentage — both parts must be greater than zero.
workflow.planNote: The balance absorbs rounding. For three or more installments or uneven amounts, add linked payment requests one by one.
workflow.planNeedsSigned: Set up the deposit and balance once the project is signed.
workflow.planNeedsQuote: Set the quote first, then split it into deposit and balance.

inbox.title: Offers to review
inbox.intro: Upload screenshots or a PDF, or paste an offer's text. We pull out the key details and suggest a type; nothing becomes a project until you confirm. Uploading and pasting are still in development — for now, use “New project”.
inbox.emptyBody: Offer intake is in development — for now, add a project directly.
inbox.pick: Pick an offer to read it.

contacts.emptyBody: Keep details for artists, brand contacts, and managers here.

files.title: Keep each project's files together
files.intro: Upload offers, contracts, assets, or invoices and keep them with the project. Archived files can be restored. File upload is in development.
files.empty: No files yet. Upload offers, contracts, assets, or invoices.

calendar.note: Items are listed by the local date they were entered in, with their time zone next to the time.

calendarFeed.title: Calendar subscription
calendarFeed.intro: Add this private link to Google or Apple Calendar and confirmed events show up automatically — no calendar account connection needed. Calendar apps refresh on their own schedule (Google can take several hours).
calendarFeed.copyNowDetail: For security it's shown only once; if you lose it, reset the link.
calendarFeed.localHint: This is a local development address (http), which webcal can't open. In Apple Calendar choose File → New Calendar Subscription and paste the link above.
calendarFeed.googleHint: Google Calendar: on desktop, click + next to “Other calendars”, choose “From URL”, and paste the link. Anyone with the link can see your schedule, so don't share it publicly.
calendarFeed.resetNote: Resetting stops the old link immediately.

settings.name: Artist or brand name
settings.timeZoneHelp: The time zone decides what “today” means and the default zone for new events.
settings.gmailBody: With the Gmail add-on installed, open an offer email and send it in with one click. The add-on reads only the email you send, never your whole inbox.
settings.aiBody: Offer analysis and drafting run on an AI service we provide — there's no key to set up. What's sent to the model is never used to train it, and every result needs your confirmation before it's saved.

editor.titleEdit: Edit {kind, select, project {project} contact {artist / partner} calendar {event / to-do} payment {ledger entry} template {reply template} other {reply draft}}

field.name: Name
field.label: Entry name
field.settledAmount: Amount actually received / paid (blank = full amount)
field.subject: Subject

editor.paymentHelp: One entry is one complete payment. Split staged payments into deposit and balance; keep it “Outstanding” until the money arrives. Received and paid totals use the settled date. If less arrives than billed (withholding tax, the NHI supplementary premium), enter the amount received — the gap is shown separately.
editor.templateHelp: You can use {placeholders}. Missing values are marked to confirm. A past reply can't be applied directly — before saving it as a template, remove the old project's names, fees, and dates.
editor.notWired: This kind of record isn't connected to the database yet — saving is in development.
editor.languageHelp: The language this reply is written in — placeholders and quotes fill in that language.
editor.quoteHelp: Leave the amount blank if the fee isn't decided yet; 0 means unpaid.
editor.signedOnly: Only signed projects are listed. Linking is optional.
editor.travelHelp: Times are local, in each place's own time zone (e.g. Asia/Taipei, Asia/Tokyo). Not connected to live flight, rail, or hotel booking data.

drafts.pastReplyRefused: A past reply is for reference only and can't be applied directly. Save it as a template first, replacing the old project's names, fees, and dates with placeholders.
drafts.libraryHelp: Each project type keeps its own. Reply templates fill in the current project's details; past replies are for reference — remove the old project's details before saving one as a template.
drafts.starterBody:
Hi {counterparty},

Thanks for inviting {artist} to “{project}”. To confirm the arrangements, could you share:
{questions}

Once we hear back, we'll confirm availability and terms. Thanks!
drafts.noTemplates: No templates for this type yet — add or import one.
drafts.import: Import a TXT / Markdown / EML reply
drafts.whatToConfirm: What to confirm for this kind of project?
drafts.subject: Subject
drafts.aiSoon: AI drafting (several versions at once) is in development; for now, apply a template.
drafts.saveSoon: Drafts aren't connected to the database yet
drafts.openGmailHelp: Opens a prefilled Gmail compose window; you review and send it yourself.
drafts.savedEmpty: Saved drafts show up here so you can pick them up again.

auth.sentVerification: We sent a confirmation email to {email}. Click the link in it to finish signing up.
auth.resetSent: If that email has an account, a password reset link is on its way.
auth.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password updated. You've been signed out on other devices.

errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: This email isn't confirmed yet. We just re-sent the confirmation email — please check your inbox.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: That email already has an account.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.invalid: That data isn't in a valid format.
errors.onlyOwner: Only the owner can change workspace settings.
errors.timeZoneInvalid: Invalid time zone — use an IANA name such as Asia/Taipei.
errors.kindSwitch: An existing to-do can't become an event, or the other way round — add a new one instead.
errors.amountDecimals: Amounts can have at most two decimal places.
errors.taxRateRange: The tax rate must be between 0 and 100%.
errors.settledDateRequired: Received or paid entries need the date settled.
errors.settledDateFuture: The date settled can't be later than today.
errors.balanceBeforeDeposit: The balance can't be due before the deposit.
errors.incomeExists: This project already has payment requests — edit those so nothing is counted twice.
errors.splitInvalid: Set a positive quote and a deposit between 0 and 100%.
errors.splitPartsPositive: Both deposit and balance must be greater than zero.
errors.counterpartyRequired: Enter a partner, or pick one from the list.
errors.languageRequired: Choose the language the reply is written in.
errors.projectNotSigned: Only signed projects can take new linked to-dos, events, and payments. Move the project to Signed first.
errors.projectArchived: This project is archived. Restore it before linking new items.
errors.quoteNotSet: Set the project's quote before splitting it.
errors.travelTimeRequired: Travel and stays need a time.
errors.wallTimeInvalid: That local time doesn't exist or happens twice (a daylight-saving change). Enter it in UTC instead.
errors.endIncomplete: Enter the arrival / check-out date, time, and time zone together — or leave all three blank.
errors.endBeforeStart: Arrival / check-out must be after departure / check-in (time zones included).
